d: A tall, muscular creature with grayish-brown skin, characterized by a head replaced by a rectangular brown wooden block with glowing neon-green circular eyes. The figure wears a dark charcoal cloak, black trousers, a wide brown belt with two buckles, and dark boots with criss-cross laces. The attire is completed by a tattered, deep crimson cape that flows behind. BODY COLOR: Grayish-brown LEGS: Plantigrade with flat, dark-colored boots.
